releases.body:
First release.

**What it does.** `doc_open` renders a file in a tmux pane with line numbers; the user drags over the lines they mean and releases; `doc_selection` returns exactly that text with the file, line range and character count.

**Security note.** The first commit interpolated paths into the tmux command unquoted, which tmux runs through a shell. A filename containing `;` executed a second command — confirmed end to end before fixing. Every interpolated value is now single-quoted, with six tests, and both directions were re-verified through tmux. Details in SECURITY.md.

**Gates.** 27 tests, and a typecheck proven to fail on an injected error. No `|| echo skipped` anywhere.

**Requires** tmux and bun on PATH.
